coding.rationale: Smoke from active hob is a hazard; extractor hood and perfumer keep kitchen air safe and clean. Smoke detection is the trigger context, devices are mechanisms.
Scheduled holiday cleaning at 9:00 when home unoccupied keeps the house clean; robot is the mechanism, split from the laundry objective.
Scheduled holiday laundry at 9:00 when home unoccupied keeps laundry done; washing machine is the mechanism, split from the cleaning objective.
Flushing restores toilet hygiene after the toilet-use event; sensor/automatic flush are mechanisms.
Bacteria threshold of 30% triggers cleaning to keep toilet hygienically clean; threshold is the trigger, not responsibility identity.
Cleaning within the 48-hour window keeps floor clean; robot vacuum is the mechanism.
Cleaning runs on set weekdays while the user is away to maintain home cleanliness; roomba and air freshener are mechanisms.
Rain event retracts the clothes airer to protect drying laundry from water damage; weather is the context, retraction is the mechanism.
Cleaning runs on Sundays/Thursdays while family is away; robot cleaner is the mechanism, split from the laundry objective.
Laundry runs on Sundays/Thursdays while family is away; washing machine is the mechanism, split from the cleaning objective.
Music must stop when the user leaves to avoid playing in an empty house; motion detector at door is the mechanism.
TV turns off after 30 minutes unwatched to avoid energy waste; viewing absence is the trigger context.
Boiler and fan turn off after 10 minutes without movement to avoid bathroom energy waste.
TV and light turn off after the room is vacated 5 minutes to avoid energy waste; leaving the room is the trigger event.
User is interested in tracking consumption and low-price windows but has not adopted the app; weak indirect evidence of the responsibility.
